footer: Lookalike growth-campaign menu for KRG Advisors, updated 30 July 2026. Nine niches, each a lookalike of the marquee brands the team has advised, aligned to KRG's four growth services (earned media -> sales, GTM + vendor sourcing, experts published/speaking, GEO / AI-search). Buyer: marketing + comms leaders, 200-10,000 staff, 10 core markets. Emails are first-person plural ('we helped X'), signed by the most relevant consultant. Each campaign sends to its full reachable pool - 5,000 is the minimum capacity, never a cap (pools run ~8,500 to ~50,000; Food 14,288, Financial 27,706, Pharma 21,341 measured live, the rest estimated). Example people are illustrative; the board's draft emails render in Navreo's voice - the exact KRG emails are in each idea and the session record. Nothing sends without your sign-off.
